Component Constructor

Component constructor is used to define components. When calling the Component constructor, you can specify the properties, data, and methods of the components.

Component({

  properties: {
    myProperty: { // Property name.
      type: String,
      value: ''
    },
    myProperty2: String // Simplified definition mode.
  },

  data: {}, // Private data, which can be used for template rendering.

  // Lifecycle function, which can be a function or a method name defined in methods.
  attached: function () { }, 
  ready: function() { },

  methods: {
    onBtnTap: function(){
      this.setData({
       // The method of updating properties and data is similar to that of updating page data.
      })
    },
    // It is recommended that an internal method start with an underscore (_).
    _myPrivateMethod: function(){
      // Set data.prop to 'myPrivateData'.
      this.setData({
        prop: 'myPrivateData'
      })
    },
    _propertyChange: function(newVal, oldVal) {

    }
  }
})
